senses.definition: (zoology) Any butterfly of the genus Vanessa.

quotes.text: The Nymphalidae are a very extensive group, of generally strong-winged and very bright-coloured butterflies, very abundant in the tropics, and represented in our own country by our Fritillaries, our Vanessas, and our Purple-emperor.
quotes.reference: 1869, Alfred Russel Wallace, The Malay Archipelago, volume I, London: Macmillan and Co., page 438:
